decision_rule: Determine grammar-free MI210 throughput parity with LLAMA_LLGUIDANCE toggled at matched C13 source and configure identity. Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MTP-Q8_0, llama-bench pp512/tg128 r5, ROCm0, ngl 99, fa 1 and 8 host threads. Higher t/s is better, with expected effect zero. Check each adjacent pair in AB, BA, AB (A=nollg). Stop on futility and FAIL if the same arm falls >2% below the other on any one metric in two pairs. After three pairs stop on answer, with PASS only if both absolute median paired deltas are <1% and within their repeat noise bands (median larger within-pair CV, floor 0.5%). Otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Require each arm to have two live own-PID KFD/VRAM and local HIP mapping samples. Publisher smoke runs the pinned small GGUF on both arms using four host CPUs inside an exclusive publisher MI210 grant.
